Marissa/Emily -

A few clarifications from InfoSec side before the kickoff:
- Systems definitely in scope: prod-api (handles PHI-transformed payloads), analytics-batch (de-identified), S3 buckets in our AWS account (raw data landing).
- Systems likely out of scope: internal dev/test clusters and CI build artifacts.
- We'll need to understand data flows (what leaves our environment vs. what's processed within Redwood), encryption at rest and in transit, and key management options (KMS/HSM).
- For a Private deployment we'll want VPC peering or PrivateLink and an audit log export for 90 days.

I'll bring a short list of technical questions to the kickoff. For the questionnaire, you can skip anything that's clearly Redwood-hosted product detail and instead point us to docs - efficient for both sides.

-Tom
Information Security - Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Acme Health

Thanks Tom - great questions, appreciate the clarity. Short replies inline so we can use these in the kickoff:

- Data flows: Redwood can accept data via our API or inbound S3 transfers. For Private deployments, we support VPC peering and PrivateLink; for hosted API customers we recommend encrypted REST with mutual TLS.
- Encryption: All customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit; for private installs we can integrate with customer KMS.
- Audit logs: We can export structured audit logs to a customer-owned S3 bucket and retain per your policy - default retention is 90 days, configurable.
- Key management: We support AWS KMS and customer-managed HSM options for Private deployments.

Agenda for Friday kickoff (30-45 mins):
1) Introductions and roles (5 min)
2) Systems in scope and data flows (10 min)
3) Questionnaire intake - quick triage of high-priority items (15 min)
4) Procurement/contract next steps and timeline (5-10 min)

I’ll send the calendar invite for 07/23 9:00-9:30 PT and include Neha (our security lead) to handle technical Qs. If you prefer a longer block, we can extend.

Best,
Marissa
